title: Resolve the apps/web nanoid advisory with the smallest lockfile-only update
objective: Use npm's configured package-manager resolution to move only apps/web's transitive node_modules/nanoid lock entry from 3.3.16 to 3.3.17, clearing GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 without changing manifests, audit policy, application behavior, or feature acceptance.
out_of_scope_zero_diff: apps/web/src/** and all other application source
implementation_constraints: Run npm update nanoid --package-lock-only from apps/web; do not hand-edit package JSON.
Resolve exactly nanoid 3.3.17, the approved registry's maximum available 3.x release.
Do not use a GitHub tarball, public-registry bypass, major override, audit suppression, forced audit fix, or internal-registry hardcoding.
Reject and reduce any unrelated lockfile churn.
Do not emit registry URLs, credentials, or internal hostnames in tracked files, commits, PR text, logs, or reports.
acceptance_criteria: A1: The untouched base audit exits nonzero with exactly GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 and the tool total '1 high severity vulnerability'; the fixed-lock audit uses the same command and exits 0 with zero high and zero critical vulnerabilities.
A2: The only product-file diff is apps/web/package-lock.json, and only the node_modules/nanoid package record changes from 3.3.16 to exactly 3.3.17.
A3: A clean npm ci after removing only this worktree's ignored apps/web/node_modules succeeds.
A4: npm explain nanoid proves postcss@8.5.25 requires nanoid ^3.3.16 and resolves nanoid@3.3.17.
A5: apps/web format check, ESLint, tests, and build all pass.
A6: pwsh -File scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit passes; if Python tests run with a database, exactly two stack-health tests skip.
A7: The pushed draft pull request remains draft and all five reported checks are green; Dependency audit contains fourteen steps and all five named audit steps conclude success.
A8: Base-ref blob/tree controls prove every out-of-scope path byte-identical; the progress append has zero deletions and an LF final byte; no secret or internal host is introduced.
A9: Temporary install, probe, and stack resources created by this session are removed without touching another session's resources.
verification_commands: cd apps/web; npm run format:check; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build
gh pr checks and GitHub Actions job-step inspection at the pushed SHA
data_and_migration_implications: None. No schema, data, migration, runtime dependency manifest, or application source changes.
